# Pilot — Pilot Booster Program for Startups

Flat $750 price for the first year covering federal and state corporate income tax filings, monthly accrual-basis bookkeeping, onboarding, and setup help for banking, corporate card and payroll.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [💳 Finance & Banking](../categories/finance.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Once you surpass that expense limit, or after one year in the program, whichever comes first |
| **When it ends** | your subscription will become the Pilot Core bookkeeping plan, starting at a rate of $399 per month, plus the Tax Starter plan, starting at $750 per year. |


### Not covered

- companies with revenue
- companies with $15,001 or more in monthly expenses

> **Stacking:** Bill pay, payment processing and R&D tax credit services are separately priced add-ons.

### Notes

Pilot publishes a first-year PRICE ($750), not a credit or a discount value, so amount_max is deliberately left null and amount_is_published false to avoid implying $750 of credit. An extra cap beyond age/revenue: 'less than $15,001 in monthly expenses at the time of signature'. Pre-revenue is required, hence revenue_max_usd 0. Eligibility quoted verbatim: "This offer is for newly incorporated tech startups under 1 year old that are pre-revenue with less than $15,001 in monthly expenses at the time of signature." Afterwards "your subscription will become the Pilot Core bookkeeping plan, starting at a rate of $399 per month".
